Strategy: Prefer leftovers that fit even counts. A leftover holding an even number of same-size items pairs up evenly, while an odd count leaves one unpaired slot. Score by leftover with a bonus when it fits an even number of same-size items, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to an even band. Exact fits rank top. It may help by keeping leftovers pairable, but may fail because the even-odd split is arbitrary and later items rarely repeat this size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if ((r - item) // item) % 2 == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Even-count band bonus: +item when leftover fits an even number of same-size items.
